messages:
Lina (Docs): Quick sync: I'm landing a short model-card update for lyra-embed-8b to add client-side sharding examples and a note about quantized limits. Can someone glance?

Ravi (ML): Confirming quantized q8 behavior: practical limit ~8192 tokens. Past that we best-effort truncate and vectors may degrade. Add a blunt caveat.

Ola (SDK): I'll swap the legacy .embed() snippet to embeddings.create and include a tiny Promise.all pattern for parallel shard requests. Also include a Python asyncio example.

Hiro (Eng): Please avoid advertising internal headers like X-Embed-Shard. Recommend deterministic hashing (stable hash -> bucket) in examples.

Lina (Docs): Good. Draft copy: "sequence_limit: 8192 — quantized variants best-effort truncate; expect quality drop near limit." I'll add a short hash-bucket example and both Node/Python snippets.

InfraBot: Redirect request filed: infra-redirects#63 to map legacy /models/lyra to /catalog/models/lyra-embed-8b.

Ravi (ML): Also add a perf blurb: "Sharding increases throughput but introduces per-shard overhead; prefer batching for latency-sensitive workloads."

Ola (SDK): Added the batch-size tip: "keep per-shard payloads under ~400KB to avoid client timeouts" and a code comment about exponential backoff on 429s.

Hiro (Eng): Redirect deployed (301).

Lina (Docs): All good. CI green after snippet tweak; merged. I'll follow up with a short release-note bullet. Closing thread. :tada:
